decision.observation: The car has remounted and sits centred on the tarmac at 8 mph in gear 1, red X cleared, all dots dark. Ahead the lane climbs and curves right past a blue puddle toward yellow tents and bunting on the right verge; a pine stands close on the right.
decision.hypothesis: The line ahead bends right, so a short throttle with right steer should follow it while the car is centred and has momentum.
decision.memory: A plain 0.8s throttle mounted the road cleanly from the grass — no steering needed when the nose is already aligned. The lane here bends right toward the tents.
